alter PROC [DW].[SP_CI_Demographics_Retail]
AS
BEGIN

DROP TABLE DW.CI_Demographics_Retail;

WITH DimAccount AS (
    SELECT * FROM DW.DimAccount 
    WHERE SourceSystemCode IN ('DEP', 'LNS', 'CCD', 'TRU', 'TRY') AND CurrentIndicator = 1 
)
,HIERARCCHY AS (
    SELECT 1 AS SEQ, 'CRM' SOURCE UNION ALL
    SELECT 2 AS SEQ, 'CCD' SOURCE UNION ALL
    SELECT 3 AS SEQ, 'SEC' SOURCE
)
,DimCustomer AS (
    
    SELECT *
    ,CONCAT('Entity_CIF_', SourceSystemCode, '_', CustomerID)  AS EntityCIF
    , NULL AS RN
    FROM DW.DimCustomer
    WHERE CurrentIndicator = '1' AND  CustomerType = 'Retail' AND GlobalCIF IS NULL

    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT DC.* , REPLACE(GlobalCIF,'Global_CIF_','Entity_CIF_') AS EntityCIF, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY REPLACE(GlobalCIF,'Global_CIF_','Entity_CIF_') ORDER BY SEQ) RN 
    FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
    LEFT JOIN HIERARCCHY B ON DC.sourcesystemcode = B.SOURCE
    WHERE CurrentIndicator = '1' AND  CustomerType = 'Retail' AND GlobalCIF IS NOT NULL 
    ) A WHERE RN = 1

)
,DimCustomerRisk AS(
    SELECT * FROM(
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerSK ORDER BY CustomerSK) RN, CustomerSK,RiskRatingTypeSK,RiskRatingSK  FROM DW.DimCustomerRiskRating
    )A WHERE RN = 1
     
)
,CI_Deposits_Retail AS (
    SELECT EntityCIF 
    ,SUM(MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full) AS MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full          
    ,SUM(MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Prorated) AS MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Prorated
    ,SUM(YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full) AS YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full
    ,SUM(YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Prorated) AS YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Prorated
    ,SUM(OutstandingBalance_Full) AS OutstandingBalance_Full 
    ,SUM(OutstandingBalance_Prorated) AS OutstandingBalance_Prorated 
    FROM DW.CI_Deposits_Retail_Random_Test
    GROUP BY EntityCIF
)
,CI_Cards_Retail AS (
    SELECT EntityCIF 
    ,SUM(RelationshipExposure) AS RelationshipExposure          
    ,SUM(StatementBalance) AS StatementBalance
    ,SUM(CreditLimit) AS CreditLimit
    FROM DW.CI_Cards_Retail_Random_Test
    GROUP BY EntityCIF
)
,CI_Loans_Retail AS (  
    SELECT EntityCIF   
    ,SUM(RelationshipExposure_Full) AS RelationshipExposure_Full  
    ,SUM(RelationshipExposure_Prorated) AS RelationshipExposure_Prorated  
    ,SUM(DueForTheMonth_Full) AS DueForTheMonth_Full  
    ,SUM(DueForTheMonth_Prorated) AS DueForTheMonth_Prorated  
    ,SUM(CreditLimit_Full) AS CreditLimit_Full  
    ,SUM(CreditLimit_Prorated) AS CreditLimit_Prorated 
    FROM DW.CI_Loans_Retail_Random_Test  
    GROUP BY EntityCIF
)
,CI_Securities_Retail AS ( 
    SELECT EntityCIF 
    ,SUM(PortfolioSize_Full) AS PortfolioSize_Full  
    ,SUM(PortfolioSize_Prorated) AS PortfolioSize_Prorated  
    FROM DW.CI_Securities_Retail_Random_Test 
    GROUP BY EntityCIF  
)
,CI_Trust_Retail AS ( 
    SELECT EntityCIF 
    ,SUM(AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Full) AS AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Full  
    ,SUM(AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Prorated) AS AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Prorated  
    FROM DW.CI_Trust_Retail_Random_Test  
    GROUP BY EntityCIF  
)
,CI_Treasury_Retail AS ( 
    SELECT EntityCIF 
    ,SUM(OutstandingInvestment_Full) AS OutstandingInvestment_Full  
    ,SUM(OutstandingInvestment_Prorated) AS OutstandingInvestment_Prorated  
    FROM DW.CI_Treasury_Retail_Random_Test  
    GROUP BY EntityCIF  
)

SELECT
CustomerID
,CustomerName
,GlobalCIF
,EntityCIF
,CustomerType
,Birthdate
,MaritalStatus
,Gender
,MobileNumber
,EmailAddress
,AddressLine1
,AddressLine2
,City
,Province
,ZipCode
,Country
,EmployerName
,OfficeAddressLine1
,OfficeAddressLine2
,OfficeCity
,OfficeProvince
,OfficeZipCode
,OfficeCountry
,Industry
,Occupation
,Tenure
,TotalRelationshipBalance_Full
,TotalRelationshipBalance_Shared
,TRB_Full
,TRB_Shared
,TotalMTDADBPHPDeposits_Full
,TotalMTDADBPHPDeposits_Shared
,TotalYTDADBPHPDeposits_Full
,TotalYTDADBPHPDeposits_Shared
,TotalOutBalPHPDeposits_Full
,TotalOutBalPHPDeposits_Shared
,TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_Full
,TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_Shared
,TotalOutBalPHPLoans_Full
,TotalOutBalPHPLoans_Shared
,TotalCreditLimitLoans_Full
,TotalCreditLimitLoans_Shared
,TotalOutBalPHPCards
,TotalOutstandingBalanceCards
,TotalCreditLimitCards
,TotalRelationshipExposureLoansCards_Full
,TotalRelationshipExposureLoansCards_Shared
,TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSEC_Full
,TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSEC_Shared
,TotalFundValueTrust_Full
,TotalFundValueTrust_Shared
,TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRY_Full
,TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRY_Shared
,DataPrivacyConsent
,LastKYCDate
,RiskRatingType
,RiskRating
,SuspendedIndicator
,ATMEnrollmentIndicator
,MBKEnrollmentIndicator
,RIBBOBEnrollmentIndicator
,PayrollIndicator
,GenerationalCohort
,MarketSegment 
,LastUpdatedDate
,BusinessDate                                                                                                                               
INTO DW.CI_Demographics_Retail  
FROM (
SELECT 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY DDC.CUSTOMERID ORDER BY DA.PayrollIndicator DESC) RN
,DDC.CustomerId AS CustomerID
,DDC.EntityCIF AS CustomerName
,DDC.GlobalCIF AS GlobalCIF
,DDC.EntityCIF AS EntityCIF
,DDC.CustomerType AS CustomerType
,'01-01-1900' AS Birthdate
,DDC.MaritalStatus AS MaritalStatus
,DDC.Gender AS Gender
,'****-***-****' AS MobileNumber
,'********@mail.com' AS EmailAddress
,'********' AS AddressLine1
,DDC.AddressLine2 AS AddressLine2
,DDC.City AS City
,DDC.Province AS Province
,DDC.ZipCode AS ZipCode
,DDC.Country AS Country
,DDC.EmployerName AS EmployerName
,DDC.OfficeAddressLine1 AS OfficeAddressLine1
,DDC.OfficeAddressLine2 AS OfficeAddressLine2
,DDC.OfficeCity AS OfficeCity
,DDC.OfficeProvince AS OfficeProvince
,DDC.OfficeZipCode AS OfficeZipCode
,DDC.Country AS OfficeCountry
,DDC.Industry AS Industry
,DDC.Occupation AS Occupation
,(YEAR(getdate()) - Year(MIN(DA.AccountOpenedDate))) AS Tenure
,ISNULL(CDR.YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full,0) + ISNULL(CTR.AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Full,0) + ISNULL(CTRR.OutstandingInvestment_Full,0) AS TotalRelationshipBalance_Full
,ISNULL(CDR.YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Prorated,0) + ISNULL(CTR.AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Prorated,0) + ISNULL(CTRR.OutstandingInvestment_Prorated,0) AS TotalRelationshipBalance_Shared
,ISNULL(FTR.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull,0) as TRB_Full
,ISNULL(FTR.TotalRelationshipBalanceProrated,0) as TRB_Shared
,CDR.MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full AS TotalMTDADBPHPDeposits_Full
,CDR.MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Prorated AS TotalMTDADBPHPDeposits_Shared
,CDR.YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full AS TotalYTDADBPHPDeposits_Full
,CDR.YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Prorated AS TotalYTDADBPHPDeposits_Shared
,CDR.OutstandingBalance_Full AS TotalOutBalPHPDeposits_Full
,CDR.OutstandingBalance_Prorated AS TotalOutBalPHPDeposits_Shared
,CLR.RelationshipExposure_Full AS TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_Full
,CLR.RelationshipExposure_Prorated AS TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_Shared
,CLR.DueForTheMonth_Full AS TotalOutBalPHPLoans_Full
,CLR.DueForTheMonth_Prorated AS TotalOutBalPHPLoans_Shared
,CLR.CreditLimit_Full AS TotalCreditLimitLoans_Full
,CLR.CreditLimit_Prorated AS TotalCreditLimitLoans_Shared
,CCR.RelationshipExposure AS TotalOutBalPHPCards
,CCR.StatementBalance AS TotalOutstandingBalanceCards
,CCR.CreditLimit AS TotalCreditLimitCards
,CLR.RelationshipExposure_Full + CCR.RelationshipExposure AS TotalRelationshipExposureLoansCards_Full
,CLR.RelationshipExposure_Prorated + CCR.RelationshipExposure AS TotalRelationshipExposureLoansCards_Shared
,CSR.PortfolioSize_Full AS TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSEC_Full
,CSR.PortfolioSize_Prorated AS TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSEC_Shared
,CTR.AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Full AS TotalFundValueTrust_Full
,CTR.AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Prorated AS TotalFundValueTrust_Shared
,CTRR.OutstandingInvestment_Full AS TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRY_Full
,CTRR.OutstandingInvestment_Prorated AS TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRY_Shared
,DDC.DataPrivacyConsent AS DataPrivacyConsent
,DDC.LastKYCDate AS LastKYCDate
,DDRT.RiskRatingTypeName AS RiskRatingType
,DDR.RiskRatingName AS RiskRating
,DDC.SuspendedIndicator AS SuspendedIndicator
,DDC.ATMEnrollmentIndicator AS ATMEnrollmentIndicator
,DDC.MobileBankingEnrollmentIndicator AS MBKEnrollmentIndicator
,DDC.OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator AS RIBBOBEnrollmentIndicator                                                                                                                                  
,CASE
    WHEN DA.PayrollIndicator = 'Y' THEN DA.PayrollIndicator 
    ELSE 'N' END AS PayrollIndicator
,DGC.GenerationalCohortName AS GenerationalCohort 
,  CASE WHEN DDM.MarketSegmentID IS NULL AND ISNULL(CDR.YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Prorated,0) + ISNULL(CSR.PortfolioSize_Prorated,0) + ISNULL(CTR.AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Prorated,0) + ISNULL(CTRR.OutstandingInvestment_Prorated,0) >  10000000
             THEN 'VIP'
        WHEN DDM.MarketSegmentID IS NULL AND ISNULL(CDR.YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Prorated,0) + ISNULL(CSR.PortfolioSize_Prorated,0) + ISNULL(CTR.AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Prorated,0) + ISNULL(CTRR.OutstandingInvestment_Prorated,0) <  1  
             THEN 'MM'
        ELSE DDM.MarketSegmentName END AS MarketSegment 
,DDC.ValidStartDate AS LastUpdatedDate
,FTR.BusinessDateSK AS BusinessDate
FROM 
DimCustomer DDC
JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DDCA ON DDC.CustomerSK = DDCA.CustomerSK 
JOIN DimAccount DA ON DDCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN CI_Deposits_Retail CDR ON CDR.EntityCIF = DDC.EntityCIF
LEFT JOIN CI_Cards_Retail CCR ON CCR.EntityCIF = DDC.EntityCIF
LEFT JOIN CI_Loans_Retail CLR ON CLR.EntityCIF = DDC.EntityCIF
LEFT JOIN CI_Securities_Retail CSR ON CSR.EntityCIF = DDC.EntityCIF 
LEFT JOIN CI_Trust_Retail CTR ON CTR.EntityCIF = DDC.EntityCIF 
LEFT JOIN CI_Treasury_Retail CTRR ON CTRR.EntityCIF = DDC.EntityCIF 
Left JOIN DimCustomerRisk DDRR ON DDC.CustomerSK = DDRR.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT RiskRatingTypeSK, RiskRatingTypeName FROM DW.DimRiskRatingType) DDRT ON DDRR.RiskRatingTypeSK = DDRT.RiskRatingTypeSk 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT RiskRatingSK,RiskRatingName FROM Dw.DimRiskRating) DDR ON DDRR.RiskRatingSK = DDR.RiskRatingSK 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimGenerationalCohort DGC ON DGC.GenerationalCohortSK = DDC.GenerationalCohortSK
--LEFT JOIN (SELECT PayrollIndicator, AccountSK FROM DW.DimAccount) DDA ON DDCA.AccountSK = DDA.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactTotalRelationshipBalance FTR ON DDC.CustomerSK = FTR.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT MarketSegmentSK, LowerLimit, UpperLimit,MarketSegmentName,MarketSegmentID FROM DW.DimMarketSegment) DDM 
ON ISNULL(CDR.YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Prorated,0) + ISNULL(CSR.PortfolioSize_Prorated,0) + ISNULL(CTR.AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Prorated,0) + ISNULL(CTRR.OutstandingInvestment_Prorated,0) >= DDM.UpperLimit 
AND  ISNULL(CDR.YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Prorated,0) + ISNULL(CSR.PortfolioSize_Prorated,0) + ISNULL(CTR.AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Prorated,0) + ISNULL(CTRR.OutstandingInvestment_Prorated,0) <= DDM.LowerLimit
WHERE (CASE WHEN DDM.MarketSegmentID IS NULL AND ISNULL(CDR.YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Prorated,0) + ISNULL(CSR.PortfolioSize_Prorated,0) + ISNULL(CTR.AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Prorated,0) + ISNULL(CTRR.OutstandingInvestment_Prorated,0) >  10000000
                THEN 'VIP'
           WHEN DDM.MarketSegmentID IS NULL AND ISNULL(CDR.YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Prorated,0) + ISNULL(CSR.PortfolioSize_Prorated,0) + ISNULL(CTR.AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Prorated,0) + ISNULL(CTRR.OutstandingInvestment_Prorated,0) <  1  
                THEN 'MM1'  
ELSE DDM.MarketSegmentID END IN ('MA', 'UA', 'VIP') OR DA.PayrollIndicator = 'Y' ) 
GROUP BY 
DDC.CustomerId
,DDC.CustomerName
,DDC.GlobalCIF
,DDC.EntityCIF
,DDC.CustomerType
,DDC.DateOfBirth
,DDC.MaritalStatus
,DDC.Gender
,DDC.MobileNumber
,DDC.Email
,DDC.AddressLine1
,DDC.AddressLine2
,DDC.City
,DDC.Province
,DDC.ZipCode
,DDC.Country
,DDC.EmployerName
,DDC.OfficeAddressLine1
,DDC.OfficeAddressLine2
,DDC.OfficeCity
,DDC.OfficeProvince
,DDC.OfficeZipCode
,DDC.Country
,DDC.Industry
,DDC.Occupation
,CDR.MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full
,CDR.MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Prorated
,CDR.YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full
,CDR.YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Prorated
,CDR.OutstandingBalance_Full
,CDR.OutstandingBalance_Prorated
,CLR.RelationshipExposure_Full
,CLR.RelationshipExposure_Prorated
,CLR.DueForTheMonth_Full
,CLR.DueForTheMonth_Prorated
,CLR.CreditLimit_Full
,CLR.CreditLimit_Prorated
,CCR.RelationshipExposure
,CCR.StatementBalance 
,CCR.CreditLimit 
,CSR.PortfolioSize_Full
,CSR.PortfolioSize_Prorated
,CTR.AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Full
,CTR.AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Prorated
,CTRR.OutstandingInvestment_Full
,CTRR.OutstandingInvestment_Prorated
,DDC.DataPrivacyConsent
,DDC.LastKYCDate
,DDRT.RiskRatingTypeName
,DDR.RiskRatingName
,DDC.SuspendedIndicator
,DDC.ATMEnrollmentIndicator
,DDC.MobileBankingEnrollmentIndicator
,DDC.OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator
,DA.PayrollIndicator
,DGC.GenerationalCohortName
,DDM.MarketSegmentName
,DDC.ValidStartDate 
,FTR.BusinessDateSK 
,DDM.MarketSegmentID
,FTR.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull
,FTR.TotalRelationshipBalanceProrated
) A WHERE RN =1
END
